Hi! I have a PR (# feat(Algebra/Colimit/DirectLimit): add Algebra structure for DirectLimit #38672) adding an Algebra structure to DirectLimit of algebras (as well as the lift map and such).
It adds an import of Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Hom (which it needs for AlgHomClass for the directed system of algebras, and AlgHom for the lift map), which resulted in it getting the large-import label.

Would it be better to move this instance and definitions/lemmas to a separate file in order to avoid adding this large import to Algebra/Colimit/DirectLimit.lean, or is this import acceptable here? I'd be happy to refactor if preferred.

This is part of a sequence of PRs where I am working towards direct limits of $C^*$-algebras.
I think just adding to the same file is fine for now
